description: Defines the SimpleEntryOperation class for managing disk cache entry operations in Chromium's net disk cache implementation, including operation types, states, and associated methods.

classes.name: SimpleEntryOperation
classes.description: Represents an operation on a disk cache entry, including its type, state, and associated data.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::OpenOperation
methods.description: Creates an open operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::CreateOperation
methods.description: Creates a create operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::OpenOrCreateOperation
methods.description: Creates an open or create operation based on the specified index state.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::CloseOperation
methods.description: Creates a close operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::ReadOperation
methods.description: Creates a read operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::WriteOperation
methods.description: Creates a write operation for a cache entry.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::GetAvailableRangeOperation
methods.description: Creates an operation to get available data range.

methods.name: SimpleEntryOperation::DoomOperation
methods.description: Creates a doom (delete) operation for a cache entry.
